demande: What is the most a customer can owe if someone uses their lost debit card and they report it within two business days?
texte: Under 12 CFR 1005.6(b), if the consumer notifies the financial institution within two business days after learning of the loss or theft of the access device, the consumer's liability shall not exceed the lesser of $50 or the amount of unauthorized transfers that occur before notice to the financial institution.
